log: Pillage (civ-clone/web-renderer#182): the action required Fortifiable, so Settlers (Worker) never got it. It is now offered to Fortifiable or Worker units, except Caravan and Diplomat. Both of those are Fortifiable, so they could pillage before; the test matrix that should have caught it had an expect() with no matcher, and now asserts.

Forest (civ-clone/web-renderer#196): PlantForest was only offered on Plains. The terrain-transform table now lists terrains per action, and PlantForest is offered on Plains, Grassland, Jungle and Swamp. ClearJungle and ClearSwamp (to Grassland) are unchanged. Rule ids are unchanged.
When civ-clone/web-renderer#34 adds a Diplomatic type, the Caravan/Diplomat exclusion should use it.
